Class Custom3DGizmoEditorBase<T>

Namespace
ISILab.LBS.Plugin.MapTools.CustomGizmo.Editor
Assembly
LBS.dll
Generic base class for 3D gizmo editors using UI Toolkit overlays. Handles SceneView UI positioning and lifecycle.
public abstract class Custom3DGizmoEditorBase<T> : Editor where T : Custom3dGizmo
